blogPosts.text:
Hello Floatplane!


You may have noticed the comment section has gotten a cool upgrade - thanks to badges!


Badges are a cool way to signify so many things about you! Right now, we only have the length of time you've been a Floatplane Subscriber, but we plan on adding more badges, like if you subscribed during a theme week, attended a livestream, or even badges gifted to special members of the community.


We think this is a cool cosmetic that allows you to showcase your support and to flex a little on everyone else.


To access your badges, click on the top right, go to settings, scroll down, and you'll have options!


Have any suggestions? Leave em down below. I will not promise anything, but there's always a small chance!


Thank you for your continuous support for Floatplane - Sammy

blogPosts.text:
Timestamps:

0:00 Star Fox 64 Remake

1:28 2026 Video Game Hall of Fame Inductees

2:38 GameStop Seeks More Money to Buy eBay

3:59 QUICK BITS INTRO

4:08 Sony Settles PlayStation Store Lawsuit

4:42 RUSE Returns to Steam

5:09 Civilization 7 Updates

5:38 Epic Games vs Apple Continues

6:16 Kids Use Minecraft to Fix NYC



NEWS SOURCES:


MAINS


NINTENDO LOVES THEIR REMAKES

Star Fox is landing in the Switch 2 next month and while it’s technically another remake of Star Fox 64, considering the decade-long drought, I’ll buy it - but I won't be happy about it. https://www.gamespot.com/articles/star-fox-buying-guide/1100-6539831/

Besides getting a complete graphical makeover to fit “modern standards,” 

https://x.com/NintendoAmerica/status/2052180361187115496 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vh4FtjCck8Y

the game offers a new feature letting the Gamechat use Switch 2’s camera to track your face and map it onto Fox, Falco, or Slippy in real-time during voice chat. https://ca.pcmag.com/nintendo-games/15508/in-gamechat-new-star-fox-for-switch-2-can-replace-your-face-with-8-characters 

https://sm.pcmag.com/t/pcmag_ca/photo/a/a-selectio/a-selection-of-characters-you-can-use-as-your-avatar_mcy1.960.jpg 

If going "Full Slippy" feels like a HR violation, you can opt for AR filters that give you Fox’s ears or Falco’s beak, but I'm not sure that makes it much better. https://x.com/Andy_VGC/status/2052154426010263600/photo/1 

Beyond the digital taxidermy, fans are clowning on the game because it's yet another Star Fox 64 remake - apparently the barrel roll demands eternal refreshment.

https://www.gamespot.com/articles/fans-cant-stop-clowning-on-the-latest-star-fox-reveal/1100-6539829/ 

Pre-orders are live with the digital version costing $50 dollars. 

https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/star-fox-switch-2/?srsltid=AfmBOopAVIWJEplN0EjrzoxgfX8kYaxa-PQgN-8ouCKp2QJGvl8Xf_Pr 

Good luck explaining to your therapist why your best friend’s face is now a high-fidelity frog but hey. 

https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/star-fox-switch-2/?srsltid=AfmBOopAVIWJEplN0EjrzoxgfX8kYaxa-PQgN-8ouCKp2QJGvl8Xf_Pr 

At least the memes are top-tier.

https://x.com/kristanovva/status/2052187838393827626  https://x.com/jack_luddy/status/2052152065439187082  https://x.com/lolo_aburto/status/2052166135324254375 


WE DIDN’T KNOW THIS WAS A THING EITHER

The 2026 inductees into the Strong Museum’s Video game hall of fame have been announced - https://nintendoeverything.com/2026-world-video-game-hall-of-fame-winners-announced/ 

This year’s additions are Angry Birds, Dragon Quest, FIFA International Soccer, and Silent Hill

https://www.polygon.com/video-game-hall-of-fame-inductees-2026-strong-museum-play/ 

Angry birds creative officer Ben Mattes told variety that the angry birds team is deeply honored by the recognition saying that “Characters, emotion and story are what keeps our fans coming back to our games year after year.” - https://variety.com/2026/gaming/news/angry-birds-world-video-game-hall-of-fame-1236739560/ 

These games beat out legends like frogger Glaga, Ruineskape, Skyrim and megaman - https://www.engadget.com/2164266/angry-birds-and-fifa-international-soccer-join-the-world-video-game-hall-of-fame/ 

This year’s inductees join 49 other games in the hall of fame, including Classics like Doom, the Genre Defining MMOrpg World of Warcraft , and Tamagotchi for some reason - https://www.museumofplay.org/exhibits/world-video-game-hall-of-fame/inducted-games/ 


GAME RECOGNIZE GAME…STOP

Gamestop CEO is potentially raiding the Game Informer Vault to fund or hype his eBay acquisition - https://kotaku.com/gamestop-ebay-ryan-cohen-auction-game-informer-ban-2000693746 

For context Gamestop CEO and guy who’s trying to sell you MDMA at a skrillex concert, made an entirely unsolicited 56 billion dollar bid to try and buy ebay - https://www.bnnbloomberg.ca/business/company-news/2026/05/04/gamestop-makes-bold-us56b-play-for-ebay-ready-to-go-hostile/ 

It’s been going badly for Cohen as he exposed on CNBC that he has no clue how he’s going to pay for it where he’s going to - stunning the newscaster into silence - https://kotaku.com/gamestop-ceo-ryan-cohen-cnbc-interview-ebay-stocks-2000693270 

Which leads us to the game informer vault fire sale - https://80.lv/articles/gamestop-ceo-is-reportedly-selling-stuff-from-game-informer-vault-on-ebay-to-pay-for-ebay 

For those of you that don’t know Game informer was a magazine that was a video game magazine that began in 1991, at first a six-page booklet handed out free in every FuncoLand (now GameStop).Back in 2000, Barnes & Noble bought Funcoland and merged it with Babbage's to form GameStop. Vault has some cool historical or rare gaming memorabilia/games

https://replay.fandom.com/wiki/Game_Informer 

Bloomberg reports his ebay account was suspended while he was trying to sell these thing in order to fund the ebay aquisition - https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-05-06/gamestop-s-cohen-says-he-s-selling-on-ebay-to-help-fund-takeover  

https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/gamestop-ceo-ryan-cohen-banned-115859538.html


QUICK BITS


STORE CREDIT

Sony reportedly agreed to a $7.85 million US settlement after a class-action lawsuit accused them of monopolizing the PlayStation Store by killing off third-party digital game codes back in 2019.

https://www.engadget.com/2163227/sony-will-soon-settle-playstation-store-class-action-lawsuit/ 

If you bought any of the eligible digital titles 

https://psndigitalgamessettlement.com/media/qeefysnv/0219-06-2026-02-26-exhibit-e-list-of-eligible-games-and-plan-of-allocation.pdf

between April 2019 and December 2023, you might see a slice of that payout. 

Court Document: https://psndigitalgamessettlement.com/media/f2sbfoy2/0190-2024-12-13-second-amended-consolidated-complaint.pdf 

No claim form is required and once settled eligible users will be automatically credited to their PSN wallet after the final court hearing on October 15th.

https://topclassactions.com/lawsuit-settlements/open-lawsuit-settlements/7-85m-sony-playstation-store-class-action-settlement/#:~:text=No,to%20receive%20settlement%20benefits 

 

OUI BACK 

RUSE the cult-hit Real Time Strategy game is coming back to Steam after years spent in licensing limbo, 

https://www.polygon.com/ubisoft-ruse-rts-pc-game-steam-release/ 

all because Ubisoft technically owned the game 

https://lmg.gg/rusedevsteamresponse 

When fans found out Ubisoft officially decommissioned the multiplayer servers back in 2024, fans were noticeably rallying to bring it back.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/21970/discussions/0/4139438760461168253/     

Unfortunately due to the licensing issue the OG devs had to fight and wait it out until getting an opportunity to re-release the game - which they have officially done and even added some extra content.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/21970/RUSE/  


ACT YOUR AGE

2K's CEO has admitted Civilization 7's most controversial mechanic, the new “Ages system” that abruptly swapped your civ partway through a game, “was a bridge too far.” https://kotaku.com/ceo-admits-civilization-7-was-a-bridge-too-far-as-it-ditches-its-most-controversial-mechanic-in-new-fundamentally-game-changing-update-over-one-year-later-2000693964 

Over a year after Civ 7’s launch, the team is now re-adding the mechanic where players can play as one civ across history in what they're calling a "fundamentally game-changing update" over a year after launch.

https://lmg.gg/civ7readdinplayingasoneciv 

https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/32iC4OXq6ksIPTpjQ9NgT4/91a156e12eb046a94341f2ea3bfc38af/IMG_0835.jpg 


EPIC BATTLE

US Supreme court sides with Epic in the Apple vs Epic lawsuit over ios fees - 

https://kotaku.com/epic-games-apple-lawsuit-supreme-court-refuses-appeal-2000693934     

Apple tried to delay the supreme court decision on monday - https://thehill.com/policy/technology/5862947-apple-asks-supreme-court-to-pause-contempt-finding-in-epic-games-case/ 

But the supreme court said apple’s tactics were anticomptitive and kicked it back to the california district court - https://www.reuters.com/world/us-supreme-court-declines-pause-order-holding-apple-contempt-epic-games-lawsuit-2026-05-06/?taid=69fb52cf083ff2000107782a 


BLOCK BY BLOCK/CONCRETE JUNGLE MINECRAFT TOMAAATOO

Polygon dropped a documentary called Battle of the Boroughs: The Kids Who Build New York City in Minecraft, 

https://www.polygon.com/battle-of-the-boroughs-full-documentary-minecraft/

covering a NYC public school tournament where teams build Minecraft solutions to real problems like food access, climate change, and city infrastructure,

https://education.minecraft.net/en-us/blog/battle-of-the-boroughs-nyc 

https://youtu.be/nLsQjV35y_U?si=j5_1r1505VFejqHK documentary

blogPosts.title: Valve Game Console Imports, German Domain Outage, Google Chrome AI Downloads + more!
blogPosts.text:
Timestamps:

0:00 Valve Imports “Game Consoles”

1:23 German Domain Outage

2:32 Google Chrome Downloads AI Model Files

3:33 QUICK BITS INTRO

3:43 Notepad++ Creator Threatens Legal Action

4:23 Reddit Pushing Users to App

4:54 Agreements Signed For AI National Security Testing

5:33 Microsoft Edge Security Vulnerability

6:04 Button Batteries Get a Safety Upgrade



NEWS SOURCES:


MAINS


WHAT'S IN THE BOX?

Valve has imported approximately 50 tons of "Game Consoles" into the U.S. from China according to customs records dug up by The Verge. https://www.theverge.com/news/923461/valve-steam-machine-frame-deck-import-records-may-2026?shem=dsdf,sharefoc,agadiscoversdl,,sh/x/discover/m1/4  

following around 90 tons of previous orders since February.

https://lmg.gg/quotepcmagvalve  

But then again it's possible all of these containers have Steam Deck handheld inside and the weight disparity is something else entirely, regardless of Valve's hardware moving again, especially after Steam Controller launched and was instantly sold out, with eBay scalpers asking three-hundred-plus. The good news is that Valve says more stock is coming,

https://www.techpowerup.com/348791/valve-confirms-steam-controller-restock-is-happening-soon#:~:text=Valve-,Steam,soon  

 and in the meantime has released the controller's CAD files under a Creative Commons license. So if you can't wait, you can 3D-print the shell and just hallucinate the rest ___.

https://www.digitalfoundry.net/news/2026/05/valve-releases-steam-controller-cad-files-under-creative-commons-license   


THE SITES ARE GOING DOWN ALL OVER GERMANY

Who and What - Germany’ dot de domains disappeared off the internet .de domains experienced hours-long outage on tuesday night https://cybernews.com/security/dnssec-failure-causes-german-internet-blackout/ 

Why - IT WAS A DNS OUTAGE caused by Denic - the organization for managing Germany’s .de domains after registry distributed faulty signatures because of a DNS outage

https://www.theregister.com/networks/2026/05/06/denic-sorry-for-dnssec-error-that-crashed-germanys-internet/5230683 

The issue is now resolved but denic explained in a blog post published today that it was due to the distribution of faulty signatures https://blog.denic.de/technische-storung-bei-de-domains-behoben/ 

The signatures are meant to ensure security for the DNS but can function as a single point of failure if they’re incorrecthttps://goosed.ie/news/what-caused-the-de-internet-outage/ 

Which explains why I couldn’t get to my favorite website hotdog.de - https://www.hotdog.de/ 


GET YER MODEL OFFA MY HARD DRIVE

Google Chrome has been silently downloading a 4gb AI model to user devices without permission https://www.theverge.com/tech/924933/google-chrome-4gb-gemini-nano-ai-features 

Initial report came from privacy expert Alexander Hanff - https://www.thatprivacyguy.com/blog/chrome-silent-nano-install/ 

Evidently it’s a 4gb AI model with the majority of the space being a weights.bit file that includes gemini Nano on device weights - https://www.tomsguide.com/ai/check-your-storage-chrome-may-be-downloading-a-4gb-ai-model-heres-what-we-know 

Researchers looking into it says that it’s possibly a violation of EU law and waste a ton of energy https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/cyber-security/google-chrome-silently-downloads-4gb-ai-model-to-your-device-without-permission-report-claims-researcher-says-practice-may-violate-eu-law-waste-thousands-of-kilowatts-of-energy 

Any attempts to delete the files to free up space causes Chrome may re-download it again in the future. 

And if you want to remove it you’ll need to head to Settings>System and toggle off the On-Device AI option - https://www.pcworld.com/article/3132803/chrome-silently-downloads-a-4gb-ai-model-heres-how-to-remove-it.html 


QUICK BITS


OPAN “SOURCE” STYLE

Notepad++ creator Don Ho is threatening legal action over an unofficial macOS port - but the port itself isn't the problem.

https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/notepad-plus-plus-creator-threatens-legal-action-over-macos-port

Ho responded on the notepad++ blog stating “This site has absolutely nothing to do with Notepad++. It’s not authorized, not endorsed, and not affiliated with the project in any way.”

https://lmg.gg/donhoblogquote 

The site uses the Notepad++ name and branding wholesale and even lists Ho himself as a contributor, which he very much is not.

https://notepad-plus-plus.org/assets/images/nppTradeMarkInfringement1.png 

https://notepad-plus-plus.org/assets/images/fakeSiteContributors.png 

Ho is asking users to reply to social posts hyping the port with a copy-pasted disclaimer, effectively crowdsourcing his cease-and-desist. 

https://lmg.gg/Userspleasereply   


NOOO DONT USE THE WEBSITE

Reddit is making an intentional effort to move mobile website users onto the dedicated app instead. 

https://arstechnica.com/information-technology/2026/05/why-reddit-blocked-my-daily-visit-to-its-mobile-website/ 

Several users have noticed that when they go onto reddits website on a mobile device they’re met with a new overlay pop up, saying, “Get the app to keep using Reddit” with no way to skip or close it, functionally forcing those users to download the reddit app.  

https://futurism.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/reddit.png 

https://cdn.arstechnica.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Screenshot_20260430-212531.png 

A reddit spokesperson told Ars Technica that they “ recently started running a test for a small subset of frequently logged-out mobile users that prompts them to download the app after visiting the site. “

https://lmg.gg/redditspokesperonarstechnica 


SIGNED, SEALED AND DELIVERED

Microsoft, Google DeepMind and xAI have signed a deal with the US Center for AI Standards and Innovation to have their AI models reviewed AI models prior to public release - https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2026/05/caisi-signs-agreements-regarding-frontier-ai-national-security-testing 

This is a reversal of the administration’s non interventionist approach to regulating the frontier companies- https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/04/technology/trump-ai-models.html 

This is likely in response to the kerfuffle around anthropic’s decision to hold claude mythos back grom the public citing concerns to cyber security. Potentially it’s a move towards regulating AI a lot more like bio weapons - https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/may/05/commerce-department-ai-agreements-google-microsoft-xai 

 

EDGE CASE

Microsoft says Edge's habit of storing logged-in passwords in plaintext in memory is a feature, not a bug,

https://www.forbes.com/sites/daveywinder/2026/05/06/microsoft-says-edge-password-security-vulnerability-is-by-design-is-it-time-to-switch-to-chrome/ 

after Norwegian cybersecurity researcher Tom Jøran Sønstebyseter Rønning reported the issue to Microsoft .

https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7457070682305130496/ 

It's also the only Chromium-based browser that does it apparently.

https://www.tomsguide.com/computing/online-security/only-chromium-based-browser-ive-tested-that-behaves-this-way-microsoft-edge-has-a-huge-password-vulnerability-researcher-claims  

Microsoft's reasoning is that reading browser memory requires the device to already be compromised

https://lmg.gg/itsalreadytoolate 


ADOLESCENT HUNGER FOR BATTERIES

Energizer's new ULTIMATE CHILD SHIELD button batteries are designed to prevent chemical burns that happen when toddlers accidentally swallow them.

following around 90 tons of previous orders since February.

<https://lmg.gg/quotepcmagvalve> 

But then again it's possible all of these containers have Steam Deck handheld inside and the weight disparity is something else entirely, regardless of Valve's hardware moving again, especially after Steam Controller launched and was instantly sold out, with eBay scalpers asking three-hundred-plus. The good news is that Valve says more stock is coming,

<https://www.techpowerup.com/348791/valve-confirms-steam-controller-restock-is-happening-soon#:~:text=Valve-,Steam,soon> 

 and in the meantime has released the controller's CAD files under a Creative Commons license. So if you can't wait, you can 3D-print the shell and just hallucinate the rest \_\_\_.

<https://www.digitalfoundry.net/news/2026/05/valve-releases-steam-controller-cad-files-under-creative-commons-license> 

  
THE SITES ARE GOING DOWN ALL OVER GERMANY

Who and What - Germany’ dot de domains disappeared off the internet .de domains experienced hours-long outage on tuesday night <https://cybernews.com/security/dnssec-failure-causes-german-internet-blackout/> 

Why - IT WAS A DNS OUTAGE caused by Denic - the organization for managing Germany’s .de domains after registry distributed faulty signatures because of a DNS outage

<https://www.theregister.com/networks/2026/05/06/denic-sorry-for-dnssec-error-that-crashed-germanys-internet/5230683> 

The issue is now resolved but denic explained in a blog post published today that it was due to the distribution of faulty signatures <https://blog.denic.de/technische-storung-bei-de-domains-behoben/> 

The signatures are meant to ensure security for the DNS but can function as a single point of failure if they’re incorrect<https://goosed.ie/news/what-caused-the-de-internet-outage/> 

Which explains why I couldn’t get to my favorite website [hotdog.de](http://hotdog.de) \- <https://www.hotdog.de/> 

  
GET YER MODEL OFFA MY HARD DRIVE

Google Chrome has been silently downloading a 4gb AI model to user devices without permission <https://www.theverge.com/tech/924933/google-chrome-4gb-gemini-nano-ai-features> 

Initial report came from privacy expert Alexander Hanff - <https://www.thatprivacyguy.com/blog/chrome-silent-nano-install/> 

Evidently it’s a 4gb AI model with the majority of the space being a weights.bit file that includes gemini Nano on device weights - <https://www.tomsguide.com/ai/check-your-storage-chrome-may-be-downloading-a-4gb-ai-model-heres-what-we-know> 

Researchers looking into it says that it’s possibly a violation of EU law and waste a ton of energy <https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/cyber-security/google-chrome-silently-downloads-4gb-ai-model-to-your-device-without-permission-report-claims-researcher-says-practice-may-violate-eu-law-waste-thousands-of-kilowatts-of-energy> 

Any attempts to delete the files to free up space causes Chrome may re-download it again in the future. 

And if you want to remove it you’ll need to head to Settings>System and toggle off the On-Device AI option - <https://www.pcworld.com/article/3132803/chrome-silently-downloads-a-4gb-ai-model-heres-how-to-remove-it.html> 

  
QUICK BITS

  
OPAN “SOURCE” STYLE

Notepad++ creator Don Ho is threatening legal action over an unofficial macOS port - but the port itself isn't the problem.

<https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/notepad-plus-plus-creator-threatens-legal-action-over-macos-port>

Ho responded on the notepad++ blog stating “This site has absolutely nothing to do with Notepad++. It’s not authorized, not endorsed, and not affiliated with the project in any way.”

<https://lmg.gg/donhoblogquote> 

The site uses the Notepad++ name and branding wholesale and even lists Ho himself as a contributor, which he very much is not.

<https://notepad-plus-plus.org/assets/images/nppTradeMarkInfringement1.png> 

<https://notepad-plus-plus.org/assets/images/fakeSiteContributors.png> 

Ho is asking users to reply to social posts hyping the port with a copy-pasted disclaimer, effectively crowdsourcing his cease-and-desist. 

<https://lmg.gg/Userspleasereply> 

  
NOOO DONT USE THE WEBSITE

Reddit is making an intentional effort to move mobile website users onto the dedicated app instead. 

<https://arstechnica.com/information-technology/2026/05/why-reddit-blocked-my-daily-visit-to-its-mobile-website/> 

Several users have noticed that when they go onto reddits website on a mobile device they’re met with a new overlay pop up, saying, “Get the app to keep using Reddit” with no way to skip or close it, functionally forcing those users to download the reddit app. 

<https://futurism.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/reddit.png> 

<https://cdn.arstechnica.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Screenshot%5F20260430-212531.png> 

A reddit spokesperson told Ars Technica that they “ recently started running a test for a small subset of frequently logged-out mobile users that prompts them to download the app after visiting the site. “

<https://lmg.gg/redditspokesperonarstechnica>

Microsoft, Google DeepMind and xAI have signed a deal with the US Center for AI Standards and Innovation to have their AI models reviewed AI models prior to public release - <https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2026/05/caisi-signs-agreements-regarding-frontier-ai-national-security-testing> 

This is a reversal of the administration’s non interventionist approach to regulating the frontier companies- <https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/04/technology/trump-ai-models.html> 

This is likely in response to the kerfuffle around anthropic’s decision to hold claude mythos back grom the public citing concerns to cyber security. On it’s surface it’s Part of an aggressive pivot into e commerce - https://www.techspot.com/news/112276-gamestop-wants-buy-ebay-aggressive-pivot-e-commerce.html 

But in reality it’s probably CEO Ryan Cohen trying to maneouver his way into a massive payday based on a 35 billion dollar bonus being on the table if he hits a 100 billion dollar valuation (10x current value) - https://www.wsj.com/business/deals/gamestop-preparing-offer-for-ebay-1678e6de

https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/fcc-votes-to-ban-all-chinese-labs-from-certifying-electronics-sold-in-the-us

There will be a 30 - 60 day period where public comments will be allowed then it will be made law - 

https://www.gsmarena.com/fcc_to_ban_smartphone_testing_in_chinese_labs_manufacturers_might_face_regulatory_hurdles-news-72659.php

If the judge agrees to the state’s demands - https://www.engadget.com/2161607/meta-says-it-may-withdraw-its-apps-from-new-mexico-if-judge-agrees-to-the-states-demands/

https://www.reuters.com/business/world-at-work/meta-ceo-attributes-layoffs-plan-capex-wont-rule-out-further-job-cuts-2026-04-30/

Charles Lieber- among the world’s leading researchers in brain-computer interfaces and convicted ex-Harvard scientist, is rebuilding brain-computer interface lab in Shenzhen -
